title: AST SpaceMobile, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: AST SpaceMobile filed an 8-K on April 19, 2026 reporting that its Block 2 BlueBird 7 satellite was placed into a lower than planned orbit during the New Glenn 3 mission and will be de-orbited. The company expects to recover the satellite cost under its insurance policy. BlueBird 8 to 10 are expected to be ready to ship in approximately 30 days, and the company maintains its target of approximately 45 satellites in orbit by end of 2026.
key_points: BlueBird 7 satellite placed in lower than planned orbit during New Glenn 3 mission on April 19, 2026
Satellite altitude too low to sustain operations with on-board thruster technology; will be de-orbited
Cost of the satellite expected to be recovered under the company's insurance policy
BlueBird 7 would have been the 8th satellite in the company's LEO network

Company maintains target of approximately 45 satellites in orbit by end of 2026
